purpose: Photo asset manifest, keyed by catalogue food id. Priority 1: foods that can appear as a daily plant (3 a Day). The owner reviews each batch before any image is added to the app; the app keeps its fallback tile until a file exists.
format: JPEG, square 1:1, 1200 x 1200 px, sRGB; file name = food id; crop keeps the subject centred (focus offset recorded in plant_photos.dart when added).
